description: QLExpress is a powerful, lightweight, dynamic language for the Java platform aimed at improving developers’ productivity in different business scenes.

latest_release.name: v4.1.4
latest_release.body:
- Feat: Added `ExtendFieldHandler` for custom field access on Java objects #443, Thanks @Ayasaz
- Feat: Added `getAssignVarNames` to extract variables assigned or updated in scripts #466, Thanks @chenjunwenhao
- Feat: Added Unicode comparison operators `≠`, `≥`, and `≤` #452, Thanks @chenjunwenhao
- Fix: Inconsistent line endings in multi-line strings across platforms; added Windows and macOS to the CI matrix #445, Thanks @addwes7
- Fix: Incorrect return values of prefix and postfix `--` operators #480, Thanks @chenjunwenhao
- Fix: Operator tokenization for assignment and adjacent unary operators #475, Thanks @chenjunwenhao
- Fix: Operator aliases not resolving to replaced operators #474, Thanks @chenjunwenhao
- Fix: Type comparison incorrectly treating same-named classes from different class loaders as the same type #482, Thanks @qchole
- Fix: Scope leakage in `getOutVarNames` for lambdas, try/catch blocks, and traditional for loops #468, Thanks @chenjunwenhao
- Fix: Failed compilations remaining in the cache and preventing retries #470, Thanks @chenjunwenhao
- Fix: Exception causes being lost during error handling #453, Thanks @chenjunwenhao
- Fix: Lambda proxy invocation of non-abstract methods #471, Thanks @chenjunwenhao
- Fix: Primitive array support for the `in` operator and `.length` access #461, Thanks @chenjunwenhao
- Fix: Null operand handling in the `||` operator #460, Thanks @chenjunwenhao
- Fix: Missing fields throwing errors when `avoidNullPointer` is enabled #476, Thanks @chenjunwenhao
- Fix: Constructor error handling and varargs calls with insufficient arguments #456, Thanks @chenjunwenhao
- Fix: LIKE wildcard matching and backtracking #449, Thanks @chenjunwenhao
- Fix: Tracepoint display for variable selection #450, Thanks @qchole
